name: lead-chip-detail
note: Round 8 (operator UAT 2026-08-09: 'clicking the I icon on a track... goes directly to the solo view. I don't see how I get to the song edit view - especially on a newly created progression'). The details chip routing contract: (1) a saved progression's chip opens the PRACTICE detail (chords + Edit + the Solo row) - never the Studio; (2) a chordless custom's detail IS the Add/Edit form (nothing to view yet); (3) a catalog yt TRACK keeps the Studio as its detail (its key/scale HUD is its content) - and a body tap still plays. Seeded custom songs on the runner's default ukulele profile.
